title: Joining rigidity for rational maps
summary: We initiate a joining rigidity theory for rational maps on the Riemann sphere $\mathbb P^1=\mathbb P^1(\mathbb C)$. Let $f_1,f_2\colon\mathbb P^1\to\mathbb P^1$ be rational maps of degree at least $2$, and $μ_1,μ_2$ their respective measures of maximal entropy, whose supports are the Julia sets $J(f_1)$ and $J(f_2)$. We study ergodic joinings of the systems $(J(f_1),f_1,μ_1)$ and $(J(f_2),f_2,μ_2)$, namely ergodic probability measures on $J(f_1)\times J(f_2)$ which are invariant under $f_1\times f_2$ and whose marginals are $μ_1$ and $μ_2$.
